name: local-helper-ownership
goal: Move every confirmed single-consumer helper beside its owner using the complete runtime consumer inventory, preserving definitions, shared access and registered history.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The corrected scan counts named functions in all registered source kinds: 404 shared, 411 single-consumer, 67 without a counted consumer. Move the 411 confirmed private helpers; preserve genuinely shared definitions and stable identities.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Synthetic unit-index relocation coverage did not check actual repository placement. The migration ledger, definition fingerprints and owner-folder assertions cover all 411 confirmed private helpers. The ledger is frozen explicitly as a regression input.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Corrected test-only commit 7c6d3e74 fails all 411 missing owner-local definitions. Record 6bd8dbaf7702f0d4def2518d67c934f264229bf45f53ab3480ac8617e7ee2894 freezes both the test and migration ledger.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Confirmed private definitions and their supporting declarations move beside terminal owners. Mixed modules keep shared implementations available, registered identities remain unchanged, and temporary forwarding modules preserve frozen regression inputs until proof is recorded.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
